The agency entrusted with drug safety is choosing the narrative over the data.

articles.title: Curcumin Demonstrates Targeted Anticancer Activity in Sarcoma Cells — Big Pharma Has Zero Financial Interest in Telling You

Even Memorial Sloan Kettering acknowledges turmeric's potential, yet pharmaceutical development of patentable curcumin-based therapies remains glacially slow. Natural compounds that can't be monopolized don't get fast-tracked.
